insert into ops_records (report_id, tab, ref, payload, severity, severity_why, updated_at)
select x.report_id, x.tab, x.ref, x.payload, x.severity, x.severity_why, x.updated_at::timestamptz
from jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb)
  as x(report_id text, tab text, ref text, payload jsonb, severity numeric, severity_why text, updated_at text)
on conflict (report_id, tab, ref) do update set
  payload      = excluded.payload,
  severity     = excluded.severity,
  severity_why = excluded.severity_why,
  updated_at   = excluded.updated_at,
  -- a row the feed itself cleared earlier comes back when it is seen again; a human clear sticks
  cleared_at   = case when ops_records.cleared_by = 'feed' then null else ops_records.cleared_at end,
  cleared_by   = case when ops_records.cleared_by = 'feed' then null else ops_records.cleared_by end

update ops_records
   set cleared_at = ($1::jsonb->>'checkedAtIso')::timestamptz, cleared_by = 'feed', updated_at = now()
 where report_id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'report_ids'))
   and tab in (select jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb->'tabs'))
   and cleared_at is null
   and updated_at < ($1::jsonb->>'runStartedAt')::timestamptz

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({report_ids: $('Build hub rows').first().json.report_ids, tabs: $('Build hub rows').first().json.tabs, runStartedAt: $('Build hub rows').first().json.runStartedAt, checkedAtIso: $('Build hub rows').first().json.checkedAtIso}) }}
